nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
### 1. subject_definitions
- <Subject 1>: A beautiful young woman with the physical features, hairstyle, and outfit defined in <Picture 1>. She serves as the main performer and vocalist (S1) who dances and sings.
- <Picture 1>: A reference image of the young woman, used as the first-frame anchor to establish the opening composition and starting pose of the video.
- <Audio 1>: A reference audio track containing a female vocal song and musical accompaniment, which is copied fully as the target video's soundtrack and synchronized with the speaker <Subject 1> (S1).

### 2. summary
[keyframe completion + audio reuse] The video opens with the exact composition of <Picture 1>, showing <Subject 1> immediately beginning to dance and sing in perfect, seamless synchronization with the fully copied audio track <Audio 1> over a 5-second duration.

### 3. retention_analysis
- <Subject 1>: fully_preserved (The character's physical appearance and costume are completely maintained).
- <Picture 1>: fully_preserved (The first frame is anchored to the reference image).
- <Audio 1>: fully_copy (The original audio track is used completely without any alterations or cuts).

### 4. detailed_description
The scene is set in a vibrant, stylish studio with soft, warm background lights creating an energetic and cozy atmosphere.

[Shot 1]
The video begins on the exact frame of <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> (S1) instantly starts dancing with fluid, rhythmic movements, swaying her body and gesturing gracefully with her hands in perfect harmony with the beat and tempo of <Audio 1>. Her facial expression is bright and cheerful. Her lips move in absolute, flawless synchronization with the vocal delivery of the song from <Audio 1>, matching every syllable, pitch, and breath of the audio dynamically: <d>[Japanese] [The lip movements of <Subject 1> (S1) are perfectly synchronized with the exact vocal waveform and singing syllables of <Audio 1> dynamically] </d>. The camera performs a slow, smooth zoom-in toward a medium close-up shot, capturing the natural movement of her hair as she sways. The video ends at 00:05.000 with <Subject 1> striking a dynamic final pose while finishing her vocal line in perfect sync.

### 5. overall_soundscape
- The physical audio track is fully copied from <Audio 1>, featuring the natural vocal resonance, breathing, and singing performance of <Subject 1> (S1).

### 6. non_diegetic_music
- The upbeat and melodic backing track from <Audio 1> plays uninterrupted from the very first frame to the very end of the video, matching the tempo of the dance.
